description: This file defines the interface 'HasParserInterface' within the SuiteCRM JSON API filters namespace. It declares two methods related to parsing: hasParser() to indicate if a parser exists, and getParser() to retrieve the SQL format of the operator.

classes.name: HasParserInterface
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for parser presence and retrieval within the SuiteCRM JSON API filters.

methods.name: hasParser
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether a parser exists.

methods.name: getParser
methods.description: Returns a string representing the SQL format of the operator.
